body: Is this on all versions (2.5.1, 2.6, master)?

Am I understanding this correctly that we subtract the outline width top-left, but don't add anything to the overall width-height of the local bounds?

The fact that the top-left is adjusted certainly makes sense to maintain a stable baseline. So the question essentially becomes whether the outline should affect the bounds size.

I currently can't think of a reason why it shouldn't. 🤔

Would this affect the line height, i.e. distance between lines?

Footnote:
Yes, I know I should not animate the outline ;)
I just want text positioning to be pixel perfect.
